newsitem.title: USA: Magellan Health to divest 95 hospitals-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Magellan Health to divest 95 hospitals-WSJ.

text.p: Magellan Health Services Inc is expected to disclose today that it is divesting 95 psychiatric-hospital facilities, the Wall Street Journal said Thursday.
The paper said people familiar with the situation believe the company will announce a sale-leaseback agreement with Crescent Real Estate Equities Inc for about $400 cash.
The hospitals will be run as a joint venture to be owned 50 percent by Magellan and 50 percent by a Crescent affiliate, the report said.
The deal, which has been approved by both companies' boards, is expected to result in a $45 to $55 million pretax loss that will be recognized in the third quarter, the report said.
